correctness.rationale: For n>=3 no two vertices of K_n are independent, so Flex(K_n) is one-dimensional. Kozlov Thm.3.4 supplies n-cycle components indexed by circular orderings and paths indexed by ordered distinct flipped vertices plus a residual tournament without a source or sink; the labeling is equivariant. A permutation with an even cycle cannot preserve an orientation, while for all odd cycles there are B(mu) edge orbits, giving N(mu)=2^B. Since a tournament has at most one source/sink, inclusion-exclusion with fixed vertices gives Phi(mu), and t ordered tuple entries must individually be g-fixed, yielding P_n(lambda). An n-cycle order is g-invariant exactly for equal-size cycles; centralizer count gives C_n(lambda)=phi(d)*d^k*k!/n. Relabeling preserves the sink-flip direction, so stabilizers act with +1 on circle H_1 and cannot reverse path endpoints. H_0 is the component permutation module and reduced H_0 subtracts 1. Every residual tournament automorphism has odd order, placing each path stabilizer in A_n. Its S_n orbit therefore splits into two A_n orbits; C_n lies in A_n iff n is odd, giving precisely one or two quotient circles. Independent complete edge-orientation enumeration for n=3..6 verified all 26 conjugacy-class fixed counts, quotient component-length profiles and the orientation preservation, and gave 4,38,728,26744 components. Finite tests corroborate the general exact proof, not replace it.
residual_risks: Proof relies on the verified published Kozlov complete-graph classification rather than independently proving that entire prior theorem.
n=3..6 enumeration alone does not establish the all-n formulas; structural proof covers n>=3.
Statement is rational homology and specified natural S_n/A_n actions; no extension to other graphs or higher-dimensional homology.

value.rationale: Graph flex complexes and natural vertex-relabeling symmetries are motivated by the published construction. Equivariant H_0/H_1 characters and genuine orbit-space homeomorphism types are natural mathematical invariants not determined by nonequivariant Betti numbers. The all-n fixed-path formula uses orientation symmetry and source/sink-free tournament constraints; the exact S_n/A_n orbit classification gives a meaningful parity-dependent change from one to two quotient circles for odd n, beyond raw component counts. This is a complete classification across all n and all S_n conjugacy types, although it is structurally quite close to known component descriptions and need not be a general-graph theorem.
residual_risks: The advance is a particular natural equivariant refinement, not a major new general topological theorem; known component parametrization makes some group-action deductions short.
Counts a_m, (n-1)! cycles and Burnside procedures are previously known/standard; novelty/value cannot be attributed to their repetition.
